language.description: Locale code for the MediaConch GUI interface (e.g., en, fr, de).

default_policy_path.description: Filesystem path to the default XSL policy file used for conformance checking.

default_display_path.description: Filesystem path to the XSL display transformation file used for rendering reports.

default_output_format.description: The default output format for MediaConch reports. Valid values: text, xml, maxml, html.

report_types.description: List of report types to generate. Valid values: implementation, policy, mediainfo, mediatrace.
